crypto.eyebrow: Crypto consulting · Central Bank of Brazil
crypto.lead: BCB Resolutions 519, 520 and 521, which implement Brazil's legal framework for crypto assets (Law 14.478/2022), have been in force since February 2, 2026. Anyone who intermediates, holds in custody or exchanges virtual assets now needs Central Bank authorization as an SPSAV (virtual asset service provider). We help you get there — from reading the rules to a running system.

crypto.knowTitle: We know how to work with the regulation — in the rules and in the code

crypto.roadmapTitle: How to build a crypto exchange from scratch

roadmap.title: Model and classification
roadmap.text: We define what the operation will do — intermediation, custody or exchange — and which SPSAV category it falls under.

roadmap.title: Corporate structure
roadmap.text: Incorporation, capital, governance and responsible officers required by BCB Resolution 520.

roadmap.title: BCB authorization
roadmap.text: Business plan, internal policies and the authorization application file under BCB Resolution 519.

roadmap.title: Compliance and AML/CFT
roadmap.text: KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, travel rule, anti-money laundering and regulatory reporting.

roadmap.title: Exchange technology
roadmap.text: Order book or integrated liquidity, wallets with segregated custody (hot/cold, MPC), Pix, APIs and back office.

roadmap.title: Secure operation

items.question: How long does it take to build a project?
items.answer: It depends on the scope. A landing page is usually ready in 1 to 2 weeks, while complete systems take 1 to 3 months. Once we understand your needs, we present a clear schedule with predictable deliveries.

items.question: Do you build fully custom solutions?
items.answer: Yes. We design each solution around your business needs — from architecture to deploy — without relying on rigid templates, ensuring scalability and long-term maintainability.

items.question: Do you offer consulting on Brazil's Central Bank crypto regulation?
items.answer: Yes. We advise exchanges, custodians, intermediaries and companies that want to operate with crypto assets in Brazil: reading the legal framework (Law 14.478/2022) and BCB Resolutions 519, 520 and 521 — in force since February 2, 2026 — for virtual asset service providers (SPSAV), compliance assessment, an adaptation plan and the technology required (KYC, anti-money laundering, asset segregation and reporting).

items.question: How do you build a crypto exchange from scratch?
items.answer: In six steps: define the business model and its classification (intermediary, custodian or exchange); set up the required corporate structure, capital and governance; apply for Central Bank authorization as an SPSAV (BCB Resolutions 519 and 520); implement compliance and AML/CFT (KYC/KYB, monitoring and reporting); build the technology (order book or integrated liquidity, wallets with segregated custody, Pix and APIs); and operate with cybersecurity, risk management and auditing. We support every step, from regulation to code.

items.question: Is there support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide ongoing post-launch support, with monitoring, fixes and product evolution as your business grows.
